chunks: As-Sayyid ar-Raḍī says: This has been interpreted in a different way as well, but on this occasion is not fit to mention here.
ai.seo_question: What does As-Sayyid ar-Raḍī mean when he says a text can be interpreted in another way but is not fit to mention here?
ai.summary: Sharif al-Radi employs the hermeneutical principle of *ta'wil* (interpretive expansion) to acknowledge that the preceding text holds deeper, esoteric layers of meaning beyond its immediate exoteric reading. By deferring the detailed exposition of this alternative interpretation, he preserves the structural integrity of the discourse while signaling the multi-dimensional nature of the Imam's speech to the discerning reader.
